motivation: Test whether solver diagnostics and surrogate components remain reliable outside the current engineering sweep.
current_limitation_addressed: Current labels exclude diagnostic-failure regimes and cover a limited grid of maturities, volatilities, rates, and dividends.
required_new_data_or_solver_work: Add new PSOR sweeps with explicit grid, domain, obstacle, complementarity, shape, runtime, and failure-regime audits.
required_validation: Compare old and new regime errors by option type, stress level, boundary band, and strict Greek mask before adding labels to training.
expected_outputs: Expanded experiment matrix, excluded-regime table, convergence appendix, and updated claim audit.

extension_name: Active learning for PSOR label selection
motivation: Reduce expensive PSOR labeling by selecting regimes where surrogate uncertainty, disagreement, or diagnostic stress is highest.
current_limitation_addressed: Current dataset uses a predefined sweep rather than an adaptive label-selection policy.
required_new_data_or_solver_work: Define an acquisition score, run PSOR on selected candidate regimes, and log every accepted and rejected label.
required_validation: Measure error reduction per added PSOR regime against a matched random-sampling baseline and retain failed acquisitions.
expected_outputs: Acquisition log, label-efficiency curve, fresh PSOR audit cases, and active-learning report section.

motivation: Attach uncertainty estimates to price, boundary, and Delta diagnostics so PSOR spot checks can be triggered by risk.
current_limitation_addressed: Current surrogate outputs are point estimates and do not quantify confidence.
required_new_data_or_solver_work: Build calibration splits and evaluate ensembles, conformal intervals, or Bayesian approximations against fresh PSOR cases.
required_validation: Report empirical coverage, interval width, calibration error, and PSOR-audit trigger precision by option type and regime.
expected_outputs: Coverage tables, calibration plots, uncertainty-trigger policy, and failure-case audit.

motivation: Improve financial consistency beyond penalty-only training by using structural constraints where possible.
current_limitation_addressed: Direct-price baselines showed obstacle and shape violations; current positive-premium model enforces only the obstacle.
required_new_data_or_solver_work: Design constrained architectures or post-training certificates for monotonicity, convexity, and option-specific Delta bounds.
required_validation: Audit obstacle, monotonicity, convexity, Delta bounds, boundary-band errors, and held-out regime performance against PSOR labels.
expected_outputs: Constraint audit table, architecture notes, violation comparison with baseline and positive-premium models.

extension_name: Improved Gamma treatment near kinks and free boundaries
motivation: Gamma is numerically delicate near payoff kinks and free boundaries and should not be treated as a routine surrogate output.
current_limitation_addressed: Current workflow reports finite-difference Gamma with masks but does not train or validate a Gamma head.
required_new_data_or_solver_work: Add finer grids, Rannacher smoothing, boundary-aware masks, and high-resolution reference comparisons before any Gamma model.
required_validation: Compare masked and unmasked Gamma errors, near-boundary behavior, grid convergence, and smoothing sensitivity.
expected_outputs: Gamma stability appendix, mask policy update, and explicit retain-or-reject decision for any Gamma surrogate.

motivation: Reduce near-maturity and kink-related numerical artifacts before making stronger Greek or convergence statements.
current_limitation_addressed: Current solver notes identify nonsmooth terminal payoff and uniform-grid resolution as error sources.
required_new_data_or_solver_work: Implement and audit active Rannacher startup steps or payoff averaging while preserving obstacle enforcement.
required_validation: Re-run analytic checks, grid convergence, complementarity, boundary stability, and Delta/Gamma comparisons against current CN/PSOR outputs.
expected_outputs: Solver-refinement report, before-after convergence tables, and updated validation gate.

expected_outputs: New methodology note, benchmark solver, validation report, and claim audit before surrogate experiments.
